author: DiscussingFilm
text:
Shadow King was considered as the villain for ‘SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY’ before Jean Grey.

The plan would've seen the telepathic villain searching for his physical body, which had been hidden somewhere in New York.

(Source: https://www.thebulwark.com/p/breaking-down-spider-man-brand-new-day-with-chris-mckenna)
